review_note: Reviewed actual canonical_marker_profiles and positive markers from run-20261010T200432Z; cluster IDs not copied from tutorial

0.rationale: T-cell CD3D/CD3E and IL7R; CCR7-rich cluster with low CD8/cytotoxic markers relative to cytotoxic T cluster. Naive-like rather than definitive subtype.
0.limitations: No independent reference mapping or protein data; CD4 lineage inferred from IL7R/CD3 and low CD8, not directly proven.

1.rationale: CD14, LYZ, S100A8 and LST1 high; FCGR3A lower than nonclassical monocyte cluster.
1.limitations: Single-donor exploratory cluster; no donor-level differential inference.

2.rationale: T-cell CD3D/CD3E, IL7R and S100A4; lower CCR7 than naive-like T cluster and low CD8/cytotoxic profile.
2.limitations: S100A4 is not lineage-specific; subtype is inferred jointly with T markers. No independent validation.

3.rationale: Joint MS4A1 and CD79A expression; canonical B genes also among positive markers.
3.limitations: Broad B-cell annotation; no naive/memory B subtype assignment.

4.rationale: Cytotoxic CCL5/NKG7 with T-cell CD3D/CD3E and CD8A/B; distinguishes cytotoxic T from GNLY-rich, CD3D-low NK cluster.
4.limitations: Some cells express IL7R; boundary cells need additional validation, no exhausted/effector subclass claim.

5.rationale: FCGR3A together with MS4A7 and myeloid LST1/LYZ; CD14 lower than classical monocytes; distinguishes FCGR3A-positive NK cells.
5.limitations: Monocyte continuum may shift cluster boundary; no precise intermediate/nonclassical subclass claim.

6.rationale: GNLY, NKG7 and PRF1 strongly expressed; CD3D/CD8B low relative to cytotoxic T cells.
6.limitations: Some CD3E expression; ambient RNA, mixed populations or boundary cells not excluded. No doublet analysis.

7.rationale: FCER1A with CST3 and positive antigen-presenting markers; FCER1A distinguishes this small group from monocytes.
7.limitations: Small cluster; CST3 shared with monocytes. Precise DC subtype requires more markers/reference mapping.

8.rationale: PPBP and PF4 highly expressed in every cell in this small cluster; platelet-lineage positive marker program.
8.limitations: 13 cells in this run; platelet/megakaryocyte lineage cannot be resolved to definitive megakaryocytes from this matrix alone.
